talas.t: Can't sleep, the radiator in the flat is banging like someone is inside it
Kayırluu tañ. Fog on the Old City road again, can't see the poplars
Morning! Cash count at 6, my eyes are still closed 🙃
Check the airport board before you go anywhere today. Fog at Talas Airport, flights held till about 10:35
Rahmat Elnur. Good thing I have no flight, I'm taking the 14 bus to school
Air quality says unhealthy for sensitive groups in Talas today. Kids with the cough, keep the windows shut 😷
Mask again then. Tyre shop smells of rubber and smoke, nothing new
Salam all. Anyone know if the Tündük kiosk opens before 8? Need a new charger cable
Kiosk opens 8. Ask for Tolgonai, she has cables in the drawer by the window
Rahmat! Adding that to my list of Talas secrets 😄
Potatoes in the cellar are fine. Wrapped them in newspaper like my father did
Tulpar Talas ticket for 12 Dec: is anyone going with a kid? Asking for the family rate
Kids under 7 go free at the gate I think. Check at the box office before you queue
Jakshı. Kids love the Hippodrome anyway, the horses are the highlight
Still on the Jibek Jolu report. Begaiym any news from the booth?
Nothing yet. Traders at the booth asking the same thing 😕
Tonight is the Thursday exchange no wait, it was yesterday! Missed it, I'm so tired 😅
Next week then. I'll bring the boorsok this time, promise
Hippodrome stables: the hay is in, 26 som a bale in the valleys so they say. Our two are happy
Hay at 26 a bale, and I'm still paying for the boots 🥾
Heard the Kyrgyz 2027 draft has 105bn som for schools. Talas chapter still not out. Anyone?
My school has 3 tables with the same broken chair. Hope the chapter comes soon
Last year they promised the same. Till the chapter is out I will believe nothing 😒
Ha, Marat with the kalpak. Are the Hippodrome people selling tickets for Saturday?
Ulak Round 11 Sat at the Hippodrome, Talas v Kyzyl-Adyr 19:00. Gates open at 18:30
We're going! Elnur, your cousin is playing?
Yes, he is on the left wing. Hope the Kyzyl-Adyr boys don't break his nose again 😂
Lunch at the nan stall: bread still 3.50 a loaf. Same as always
Rates at the booth this morning, USD 11.55 buy and 11.95 sell. Euro 12.50/13.10. Come before 2pm, after that the queue is long
So the changers are way above the bank 8.40. Who is making money here 😅
Not me, I just count it 🙃
Bank counter has been jammed since 11, everyone wants to change for the Kazakh trip
Good for the tyre shop, every second car on the Trans-Talas has a flat in this cold
Ilbirs station filmed three snow leopards on a Chatkal slope! Who has seen them?
Snow leopard? Me, never. Only tracks in the snow near my cousin's sheep pen 2 years ago
Kids will ask about this for a week. Send me the clip if it's public 🐆
Waste pact with the Swiss in Talas Oblast, valley districts are still weighing their tips. Who sorts the bins at your block?
Nobody in my block. The bins fill up and then someone takes them. Mystery
Did anyone see the Herald piece on the orchard coin? Bank of Irad hasn't said how many they minted
Ask the bank, not us 😂 Some people already bought it to keep
Apples in Chu are 3.45 a kilo now, my sister says the Chu ones are better than the Talas ones 🍎
Your sister is wrong, Chu apples are small. Bring me a sack of the Talas Antonovka
Tell your sisters the walnuts from Toktogul are 22 a kilo, that's the good ones 🌰
22 for walnuts. My aunt used to send them from Toktogul for free 😢
Pour some tea, Nurbek. Your aunt will sell again when the report comes
Customer brought a phone with the back cracked and asked me to fix the camera. Charged 1 on the back, cracked no more
Lol, fair. Rustam you are becoming a real Talas man 😄
Kids home. Who is making plov tonight? I have rice and no time 😩
Plov at 28 a plate in the Tündük, not bad. Beats your kitchen 😂
Bakyt you are a terrible cook and a worse guest 😂
Night shift cover tomorrow, anyone? I'm off by 15:00
I can do the morning if you take 13:00 to 17:00 Sunday
Deal. Rahmat Begaiym 🙏
Chatkal road is closed until spring but the Trans-Talas is ok. Driver said the Otmek is closed for the winter anyway
Trying to get to Nurzhan on Sunday. Marshrutka 38 or bus 32? Which is less cold
Bus 32, the marshrutka driver always stops for 20 minutes at the Kara-Bulak turn
Rahmat. Bus it is 🚌
Ok the Attelkom internet is still slow, Tulpar works fine though. Anyone else?
Works fine at the tyre shop. Yesterday everything was slow, today ok
Kids asleep at 19:50 for once! Miracle 😴
Inversion again, fog on the Old City. The air is heavy 😷
Irad Cup final is Sat 7 Nov, Neftchi 2–0 Attelkom. Still hurts. Tulpar was better in the league anyway
Tulpar finished second on 62, one point behind Neftchi. Don't start 🙃
Bad day at the Nurzhan ground, I'm not talking about it 😤
Ulak Round 10 in ISEZ: Talas 2–3 Dastgoh, Iyık Janyl 5–4 Nurzhan. Anyone there?
Talas lost to Dastgoh by one. Our horses saw the whole game, they were not impressed
Talas is 2nd in ISEZ on 22, Chu top on 26. Hippodrome on Saturday, we can still get the top
Jakshı attitude! We'll be in the stands with the kids and the thermos 🍵
Anyone know a 1-room flat in Talas for under 1,500 som? I'm sick of the room at the back of the repair shop
Talas 1-room at 1,000 to 1,500 a month. Ask the agent by the Tündük, he is honest-ish 😅
Honest-ish is the best Talas can offer 😂 rahmat
Coal delivery came, 4 tonnes for the winter. Pay in the morning, no discount. Typical
Our radiators are finally warm. Tell me this is not a dream
Night all, Rustam, Begaiym rahmat. Erte suuk tüştü, dress warm 🧣
Erte suuk tüştü, Aizada. Got it 😄 Night!
[sticker: salam]
Night Talas. Mask on tomorrow if you go to the bazar. Kayırluu tañ
Night. Early shift Sunday 🌙
Night. Potatoes at 5 again 🥔
Night all. Cash count at 6, I'm going to dream of dollars 💵
Night 🌙 Kids will be up at 6 anyway
Still awake. Shift tomorrow 9, the bank system froze twice today
Up before the kettle again. Frost on the potato rows, -6 on the thermometer
Cash count done, no mistakes. Going to the bazar in 30 min, anyone need dollars changed?
Wait for the 1pm rate, the morning one is bad. Hay is going up in the valleys, 26 a bale now
Saturday, mask on, bus to the hippodrome later 🐎
Morning! Air in Talas says moderate today, Nurzhan is much worse. Who is going to the match tonight?
Kids want to come to the Hippodrome at 7 but it is cold. Thermos and blankets, we'll see
Wait, which match? Ulak or the ISEZ thing?
ISEZ round 11, Talas v Kyzyl-Adyr at 19:00, State Hippodrome. Köhne Diz v Sary-Bulak right after at 21:00
We need the win. Chu is on 26, we are on 22. Kyzyl-Adyr are on 13 so should be easy
Nothing is easy with ulak. Last time Kyzyl-Adyr took a horse off our side 😤
Shoes on the horse, not the man 🤣
Morning. Got my first customer at the counter already, a Samsung with a cracked screen and a very loud child
Kayırluu tañ. Attelkom internet is back to normal this morning, finally
Good, it was crawling for me too last week
Is the 14 bus running today? Nobody on my street knows
Yes, it came at 8:10 for me. Full of people going to the bazar
Rahmat! Taking it to the Tündük then
Potatoes are 2.10 a kilo at the bazar now. Not cheap but not bad for November
Last year it was 2.40 by this time. Better buy a sack
Sack is 1.80 if you take 50kg, I already said. Stop asking 😂
Changers rate this morning: USD 11.55 buy, 11.95 sell. Don't go to the back rows, they cheat on the small notes
Official rate is still 8.40 and nobody believes it lol
Official rate is for the bank, not for us 😅
[sticker: horse_love]
Anyone know a shop that sells proper winter tyres for a Lada? Asking for a friend who is also me
Come to the tyre shop on the Trans-Talas road. Not the one by the fuel station, the other one 😄
Ok the other one. Rahmat
Going to the Tündük for plov, 28 a plate, they have a corner table for us
Plov 28 still? Ok I'll bring the kids Sunday
Thursday exchange is on 26th. Who is coming? Rustam you still owe us boorsok
I'll bring it, promise. Bought a bag of walnuts from Toktogul instead, 22 a kilo, sold out in my flat
Walnuts from Toktogul in Talas? Traveling salesman 😂
The Talasbank branch queue on Monday is going to be insane, salary day. Pray for me
Heard the Toktogul reservoir is at 82.4% and dropping. Hope the winter is kind to the power lines
Power is fine here. Coal came yesterday, 4 tonnes. Paid already, no discount
Our radiators are warm all day now. Tell me this is not a dream ☺️
[sticker: tlpr_up]
Anyone else reading about the Rim pilgrims stuck in Tashkent? A week already. Poor people
Saw that. No consul to call either, that's the worst part
My aunt was going on that pilgrimage next spring. Now she's worried
Let's pray for them 🙏
Did anyone see the Talas Herald piece on the hydrology grant? 30% cut to $420,000. Gauges stay though
Good that the gauges stay. Cutting the money and keeping the stations is a very Irad idea
Stations without people to read them are just pretty poles 😅
[poll: Going to the ISEZ match tonight at the Hippodrome?]
Yes, my horses are going to sit on the fence and judge
No, tonight I sleep. Potatoes at 5 tomorrow again
Thermos and kids, yes 🍵
Air in Nurzhan is 160 today, Talas only 90. Keep the windows shut in Nurzhan people
I'm in Talas and I still smell the refinery when I walk past the bus station. Weird
That's the wind. It comes from Nurzhan on the bad days
Going to the Hippodrome by 18:30. Who's sitting near the east stand?
We'll be near the gate, the one with the broken lamp
Found you, the thermos is already out 🍵
Kids are singing at the Hippodrome already. Talas is loud tonight 😄
Match started! Talas on the attack already
Dangerous ball, dangerous ball 🔥
[sticker: tlpr_up]
Ask me after the final whistle, my voice is gone 😅
Horses are quiet now, they did not like the shouting
Köhne Diz v Sary-Bulak starting now, we're staying for it. Cold though
Anyone watching Sunday's Tulpar women's game? Women's League is almost done, Tulpar 23 on top
Tulpar women are the real champions this year, nobody argue
Kids asleep in the car on the way home. Good night from the stands 🌙
Sorry, late. Repair shop closed, flat hunting tomorrow. Anyone seen a flat near the Tündük under 1,500?
Same agent by the Tündük. Tell him Begaiym sent you, he's still honest-ish
Honest-ish again 😂 rahmat
Night all. Mask tomorrow if you go to the bazar 😷
Night, dress warm 🧣
[sticker: salam]
Night Talas. Cash count at 6, dreaming of dollars again 💵
Night. Shift at 9 tomorrow, don't wake me 🌙
Awake already? Cash count done, now coffee 😴
Frost on the potato rows this morning. Lost nothing, thank God
Kayırlı tañ everyone 🍵 Kids want pancakes, I say no pancakes before school
Kayırlı tañ. Stop them making you cave
Kayırlı tañ! Sunday, no school for me, just marking 40 essays 😩
Morning. Going to check the flat near Tündük at 10. Wish me luck
Ask for the one with the south window, the north ones are dark all winter
Noted. Rahmat 🙏
Sunday at the Hippodrome. Horses don't care what day it is, they want their hay
Hay in the valleys is 26 som a bale now. My cousin says it was 20 in the summer, robbery
Summer hay was cut in June, that's why. Winter is always dearer, you'll see
Ok old man 😂
Morning. Anyone going to the Hippodrome for the Tulpar women's thing? Or just the Sunday horses
Women's League is done, Tulpar finished top. Nothing left to play 🏆
Right, I keep forgetting. Still, a good season
Salam. Anyone know if the bazar is open for the Sunday rows or only Saturday?
Open, the inner rows are busy until noon. Changers at the front, rates on the board
Nurbek, is your aunt's stall reopened yet?
Not yet. She sells from her kitchen, phone orders. Thanks for asking 🙏
Tell her good luck from my class, the kids made her a card
Air check before I open the window: Talas 100, moderate. Mask only if you have asthma
Still smells of the refinery at the bus station 😅
Wind is from the west today, should clear it. Nurzhan is still bad, 234 on the site
Nurzhan 234, very unhealthy. My sister there says the kids can't go out at break
Heat plant still on the old gas. They keep promising. Nobody pays for the switch
[sticker: kosh]
Who is taking the 14 to Semiz today? Aizada you still on it?
Yes, but I'm walking to Tündük first. Bus is slow on Sundays
Trans-Talas lane still closed near the North Terminal btw. Went round by the old road
Old road is fine in the day. Watch the potholes
Taxi from the centre to Kyzyl-Adyr marshrutka side is 30 som. Anyone else seen that?
The marshrutka to Kyzyl-Adyr is 30, yes. Taxi in town from 15 som, don't let them charge more
Back from the flat viewing. 1,400 for a one-room near Tündük, north side. Too dark for me
Told you! Take the south one or walk away 😂
Ok I walk away. Rahmat Begaiym
Sunday teller shift just ended, my feet are dead
[sticker: haha]
Reminder, Thursday exchange is 18:30 at the Tündük café this week, not the old place. Boorsok on me 🥟
Coming Thursday! Will bring the boorsok rule up 😅
Is the Tündük café open on Sundays?
Yes until 22:00. Chai is good
Lunch done, the kids are now building a snowman on the one white patch in the yard ⛄
First snow of the year on the Old City roofs? Looks like the mountains got it
Mountains yes, we just had frost. Snowman is the size of a loaf of nan 😂
Went to the Hippodrome stables. Both horses fine, hay is in. Plenty of straw
Good. Keep the stable warm, ventilate at midday only
Yes doctor 🐴
Changers this morning: USD 11.50 buy, 12.00 sell. Euro 12.50 / 13.10. Euros are moving today
Official is 8.40, changers are a long way off. Don't be the one who buys at the front
Ha, I'm the one who sells 😂 Buy at the back, count your notes
Anyone following the Tulparcoin price? Someone at work said it's up
Tulparcoin isn't money, don't buy it in Talas. Quote says 3.40 cents, +3.5% today, that's all
Ok ok, just asking 🙃
Quiet afternoon. Who wants to read the Alimbekov Library exhibition notice? 12 manuscript facsimiles, free, from Monday
Taking the kids Tuesday if it's free 📚
Yes, free. Bring the older ones, the facsimiles are big and they like the pictures
[sticker: bilbeim]
Nurzhan air is 196 now, Talas 106. Cold inversion over the basin again
Heat plant gas switch still unfunded, that's what the Herald says. Shame
Unfunded means nobody is going to pay. Nurzhan lives with the smog until spring
Please keep kids in at break in Nurzhan. Cough syrup at the pharmacy is fine, no need to panic
[sticker: salam]
Sheep thieves got caught, Korgoncho. Two men, 11 sheep taken, nine back. Nine is better than none
Nine back, good. Two sheep gone is still a loss for a family. Hope they had a good reason to lie about it
Ugh 😞 I hope the owner got the nine home safe
Toktogul 83% full and dropping. Power is normal in all three cities though, so someone is managing it
Exports to Uzbekistan and Kazakhstan on the contract schedule, so no cuts for us
Good, I can keep my heater on tonight 🔥
Who is going to the Hippodrome for the Irad Cup final? That's the 7th, not today
Me. Neftchi Nurzhan vs Attelkom, it's the Irad Cup final. Could be a good one
Who is going to win?
Neftchi. They are the champions, and they won the league by one point
Attelkom will make it hard though. They beat Kara-Buura 2-0 last round, don't forget
Kids want to come too 😅 Is it a family match?
Families yes, the stands near the gate are fine
Pass the thermos, I'm freezing at the window 🍵
Sticker of the day coming up: [sticker: chai]
Anyone at the Tündük tonight? Want to try the chai before Thursday
We're here after 19:00, the window table
Salam. Does the Fergana Gateway need chains now? Driver said yes past Ala-Bel
Chains or winter tyres required, yes. Suusamyr is closed for the winter anyway, don't try it
I sell winter tyres on the Trans-Talas road 😄 Come before the snow
Marat advertising in the chat again 😂
Only when someone asks. Nurbek asked
Diesel in the Chatkal villages is 8.55 to 9.75 now, Gulzada's cousin told me. Brutal
Brutal indeed. Petrol 95 in town is 5.85 at least 😅
[sticker: tlpr_down]
Walnuts at Toktogul bazar 22 som a kilo. My uncle says the crop was small. Shopping list for the weekend
Small crop, yes. Apples in Chu 3.45 so the fruit is cheap up there at least
Ulak in Kara-Bulak this week? Kids want to watch. Dastgoh vs Kara-Bulak on Saturday, Dastgoh won 5-2
Kara-Bulak lost 5-2 to Dastgoh, yes. Ulak not football, that's the Highland thing, different
Right right, ulak. My horses prefer it anyway 🐎
Anyone else cold? Radiator in the new flat is ice. Going to borrow an electric heater
Ask the agent, he's honest-ish. Heating season is on, he should fix it
Begaiym you're my hero 😂
Kids asleep. Sunday evening is my only quiet hour 🌙
Tulpar women's last round, Attelkom 3-0 Neftchi, Universitet 3-2 Iyık Janyl. Tulpar drew 2-2 with Akademiya
Tulpar still top of the women's table. 23 points, nobody can catch them now
Good season for them 💜
Mask for the bazar tomorrow, Bakyt said. I will obey
Good girl. Air is bad in the lower bazar, I can smell it from here
[sticker: horse_love]
Night all. Tomorrow the lost dog story again, I hope nobody's dog runs off 😅
Night Nurbek. Bars is home, he's asleep on the radiator 🐶
Night everyone. Dress warm 🧣
Night. Monday early shift, the 14 better be on time
Night Talas. Cash count at 6 again 💵
Night. Hippodrome Saturday 12 Dec for the play-offs if anyone wants tickets 🏇
Night. Horses are asleep, good 🐴

nurzhan.t: Доброе утро, Нуржан! Пятница. Дома +14, батареи чуть тёплые 🙂
Доброе. Я с ночи, еле живой. Туман на Талас, в аэропорту задержки, но у нас тут смог
Смог 152 по их шкале, это уже не шутки. Дети в школу в масках пойдут?
Мои пойдут с маской, и я им сказала не спорить 😅
Андрей, а на смене гул был ночью? Из-за запуска с пятой?
Был, но недолго. Сказали не пугаться, я и не пугался 😄
Good morning! Dilnoza, did the coins go well? Igor said Volkov was coming at 7 🙂
Доброе! Волков пришёл в семь, посмотрел и сказал: сначала публикация, потом музей. Пока всё как вчера
Ну хоть посмотрели, уже прогресс 🙃
Ребят, в Талас кто сегодня? Говорят, рейсы стоят до 10:35
Kostya, я бы на маршрутке. 38 и без сюрпризов, аэропорт не нужен
Ага, так и думал, спасибо 👍
Кстати, на Дастгохе вода сегодня опять по громкоговорителю? Или это вчера было
Вчера было, сегодня вроде нормально. Набирайте в ванну всё равно 😉
Коллеги, обед! Кто в аптеке по цене пшеницы? Нет, шучу. Кто хлеб берёт в Навбахоре, там нан по 3.50 как вчера?
По 3.50 брала утром, ровно. Хлеб в Нуржане не дорожает, это уже хорошо
Хорошо, что хлеб не дорожает. Бензин вот 5.40 на 92-м, я вчера заправился, это ок
Дизель 6.10 на заправке у завода. Для машин на вахту норм
Rahmat all! I found a flat in Dastgoh, one room. Is the heating OK there?
Айгерим, на Дастгохе батареи бывают холодные в начале сезона, потом выравнивается. Спросите соседей
И окна проверьте, у нас с востока дует 😄
Ha, Aibek warned me! 😄 Okay I will check 🙂
Кто видел, Иык-Жаныл в AQI 85, умеренно. Это у них туман ушёл? Наш 152 на всю Нуржан
Там низина ниже, холодный воздух стоит у нас. Поэтому и видно разницу
Дети спрашивают, почему в Иык-Жаныле дышать легче 🙃 Не знаю, что им ответить
Скажи, что в Иык-Жаныле своя труба 😂
Смена через час. Суббота: Нуржан против Семиза в 16:00 на Чу-плаце, я после ночи, может не успею
Андрей, успеешь, ты же знаешь, что Нуржан без тебя не играет 🙂
Семиз 2 очка в таблице ульяка, им тяжело, но игра же 🙂
Я в 16:00 там, Волков отпустил
[sticker: tlpr_up]
Вечер, батареи горячие! Окно не открываю, слово дала 😅
Ребят, хто ещё на субботу в Талас на ульяк? Айбек, Талас на 19:00 в Иык-Жаныле
Kostya, я на ИСЭЗ-игру в Талас поеду. Талас–Кызыл-Адыр в 19:00 на Государственном ипподроме
Ой, перепутал, ладно. Всё равно в субботу на Чу-плац
Все мы тут перепутаем 😅 Главное, в субботу ждём всех на Чу-плаце
Кто за чай после Чу-плаца? Айгерим, ты звала 🫖
Yes! Tea at mine after the match. Bring your kids too 🙂
Я буду. Айгерим, а где ты живёшь, Дастгох или Навбахор?
Dastgoh! Near the works. Hopefully the windows are closed 😄
Айгерим, раз ты на Дастгохе, заходи на нашу площадку, там ребята играют по субботам
Кстати, про обогрев: Иык-Жаныл сейчас mainly clear, +9 днём. У нас +5 и туман по всей Нуржане. Одевайтесь тепло
Сегодня по Тулпар-Талас вчерашний новый мем в группе, видели? Тулпар второй, отрыв один очко у нас
Нефтчи чемпион уже, Андрей 😄 Не надо нам мемы про таблицу
Чемпион, да. Просто приятно 🙂
В Политехе говорят, цена газа для котельных всё ещё не опубликована. Совет молчит
Игорь, опять про газ? Мы замёрзнем раньше, чем цену узнаем 😅
[sticker: kosh]
Кто сегодня видел, что Тулпар Талас в таблице 62 очка? Талас снова догоняет 🙂
Талас догонит, а Нефтчи уже 63, не зарубить 😄
Ребят, у нас сегодня жена бухгалтера говорила: в строительной фирме зарплату выдали, но цемент опять подорожал. Вот так
Цемент и у нас в аптеке не при чём, но детям на зиму нужны ботинки, они за неделю выросли 😩
Сургут: кто на вахту в ноябре, пишите. Тут теперь переводы через банк, 1–2% комиссии
Через Talasbank это 1,2–2,5%, уже писал. Дорого, но спокойнее
Спокойной ночи, Нуржан. Завтра в 16:00 Чу-плац, не забудьте флаг 🙂
Спокойной ночи! Айгерим, чай в субботу, я принесу печенье
Good night all! See you on Saturday 🙂
Топите, но окна держите закрытыми 🙂 Всем спокойной ночи
[sticker: jakshi]
Не спится. Кто-нибудь знает, Нефтчи в субботу на Чу-плаце играет или это не у нас?
Игорь, ты спишь? Ты же у нас в курсе всего 😄
Доброе утро! Дома +4, батареи тёплые только на кухне 🙄
Доброе. На смене ночью было -5 у проходной. Туман стоит, дышать тяжело
Нуржан сегодня AQI 160, опять inversion. Пожилых родителей не выпускаю, дети в школе в масках 😩
Маски в школе это уже норма? Когда я училась, такого не было
В Политехе датчики на крыше показывали 68.9 PM2.5 вчера вечером. Окна в лаборатории не открываем вообще
Morning! Is the air always like this? In Talas it was not so bad yesterday
Айгерим, доброе! В Таласе обычно лучше, у нас котельные и НПЗ рядом 🙂 Главное окна закрывать
Ветер с востока — тогда и на Дастгохе хуже. Сегодня, похоже, с востока 😄
Ha ha, I'll remember! Rahmat 🙏
Ребят, на Чу-плац в 16:00 сегодня? Или в субботу ещё в 16:00? Путаюсь уже
Kostya, сегодня суббота, Чу-плац в 16:00, это ты не перепутал. Плац Нуржан – Ак-Суу, Dastgoh не при чём 😅
Ну вот видите, я же говорил 😂
Кто идёт на Чу-плац? Я Дамира беру, он третий раз в этом сезоне
Я после смены в 15:00 приду, если успею. Андрей на Нефтчи 🙂
Я приду с флагом, если кто ещё забыл 🙂
Печенье уже испекла, но у меня одна духовка и она барахлит 🙈
Oy, I can bring bread from the bazaar, nan 3.50 som loaf, fresh one at the corner 🙂
Айгерим, хлеб тоже хорошо. Чай у тебя на Дастгохе в какое время?
After the match, around 17:30? Aibek, will your boys be on the pitch?
Да, в 17:00 у нас игра на площадке, потом заходите 👍
Кто видел, Нефтчи вчера в таблице, Тулпар 62 — Талас тоже в тридцатке? 😂 Шучу. Ну, Тулпар 62
Тулпар 62, мы 63. Чемпионы уже, но отдыхать не будем, Кубок 7 ноября! 🏆
Кубок 7 ноября это 2:0 с Аттелкомом по-моему? Кто же помнит 🙂
Мальчики, финал Кубка ещё не сыгран, вы его уже выиграли 😅 Ждём 7-го
Наши с Дастгоха говорят, вода опять до 14:00 не будет. Кто знает, что с трубами?
У нас тоже бывает. Набирайте заранее, как я говорила 😉
Оксана, если по громкоговорителю не объявили, это точно плановый ремонт. Звоните в ЖЭК, не в газету
Звонила. Там сказали «в течение дня». Ну, понятно 🙄
Сургут: кто-то уже оформил перевод через Талас-банк? Комиссия 1–2%, я думаю всё-таки через Казахстан 🤔
Через Казахстан не лучше, везде свои нюансы. Главное не везти много наличных
Шурин говорил, курс в Базаре сегодня 11.95 продажа доллара. Дорого 😩
Kostya, не продавай то, что нужно детям 😄 Лучше купи им ботинки, они растут 🥾
Sorry, a silly question: a bale of hay in the valleys is 26 som? My cousin keeps horses in Talas. Is it a lot?
Для Таласа тюк сена за 26 — нормально, в долинах так и есть. Зимой цена растёт, это точно
Ok good. My cousin says it is more in the city 🙂
Аи, на Чу-плаце ветер, дети замёрзли, чай уже хочется 🫖
Оксана, идите к Айгерим, там тепло, у неё окна закрыты 😄
Yes come! I have hot tea and Dilnoza's cookies 🙂
Кто смотрит расписание Таласа на вторник? Ульак Тартыш Кара-Булак в ISEZ, говорят в 19:00 на ипподроме
Это ИСЕЗ, Игорь, ульак. Кара-Булак в 17-м ряду 🙂 Не там ищешь
Ага, точно. Ульак, не футбол. Спасибо, Костя
Тулпар Талас проиграл? Гоню за Тулпаром 😄
Андрей, не о тех речь. Сегодня у нас Нуржан в ИСЕЗ играет с Семизом в 16:00 на Чу-плаце, ты не с нами?
Мы на Чу-плаце в 16:00 не успели. Простите 😅 Завтра на вахте
Айгерим, спасибо за чай. Печенье Дилнозы тоже супер 🍪
Ну, спасибо. Духовка всё-таки пережила день 😄
Дастгох против Кара-Булака завтра в 16:00 на нашем ground, приходите болеть
Айбек, ты уже тренер? 😄 Приду, если дети не устроят бунт
Говорят, у Политеха нет ответа по газу для котельных, Совет так и не опубликовал тариф. Опять 🙃
Игорь, ты уже не спишь? 😂 Лучше смотри в свою лабораторию и монеты
Good night! Tomorrow I go to the refinery in the morning 🙂
Айгерим, удачи на первой смене! Не забудь шарф 🧣
Кто на Сургут в ноябре всё-таки едет? Перевод через Талас-банк 2.5% в прошлый раз, это много
Андрей, пиши в личку, тут же не банк 😄
Топите, но окна держите закрытыми 🙂 Всем спокойной ночи
Спокойной ночи! Завтра утром опять туман, наверное
Спокойной ночи, Нуржан 🌙
[sticker: kalpak]
Не сплю, на смене отчёт по котельной 😩
Костя, ты в ночь? Иди спать, котельная без тебя не остынет
Доброе утро, Нуржан! Дома +14, на улице туман как молоко 🌫️
У нас на Дастгохе воды опять нет до 13:00, объявили по громкоговорителю
Опять 😤 Опять набирайте в ванну
Мы уже набрали, Оксана 😄
Доброе. Я с ночной сдал смену, спать как убитый. Воздух сегодня как резина, в горле жжёт
Андрей, ты уже видел? Herald пишет AQI 234 на Нуржане. Дети в садик в масках пойдут 😷
Наш датчик на Политехе показал 196 вчера. Сегодня хуже. Тоже в лаборатории окна не открываем
Игорь, а откуда у вас датчик? Свой купили?
Университет поставил два, один на крыше. Но цифры всё равно никто не публикует нормально 🙃
Good morning! First shift done. Nurzhan air is strong today 😅 My eyes are red
Айгерим, ты как? Дома сидишь или на работу ходишь? Не забудь шарф и воду
Rahmat Svetlana 🙂 Работа в помещении, это ок. Но дышать тяжело, как будто бежишь
Айгерим, в лаборатории у нас фильтры на окнах, помогает. Дома влажная тряпка на батарее
Herald в редакционной статье пишет, что Нуржану нужен источник данных, дата перехода котельных на газ и цифра по мусору. Согласен на все три
Газ на котельные опять без цены. Десять миллионов дали, а тариф где? Как всегда
Андрей, ты опять про тариф 😄 Лучше скажи, в Сургут в ноябре едешь или нет?
Не знаю ещё. Через Талас-банк 2.5% тоже не радует
Андрей, личка 😄
Кстати, в Таласе сено в долинах 26 тюк. Зимой будет дороже, я вам говорю
Аи, Айбек, ты всё про сено. У нас в бухгалтерии уже цены на дрова считают 😩
My cousin in Talas buys hay for horses too, he says the same 🙂
Коллеги, в лаборатории прислали список по монетам Рабат-и-Сафеда. Пока нет решения, куда их, музей или университет
Пока никто не решил. Зато у меня приборы на холоде, ночью в лаборатории +9
Нуржан, кто в курсе, закрытие на Навбахоре школа? Дочь говорит, в столовой ещё не работают
Обещали к ноябрю, а уже 22-е 🙃 Столовая пока не работает, ребята с собой приносят
Обед, на заводе всё норм. Ветер с востока, окна у нас закрыты как и вчера
Айбек: ветер с востока, закрыть окна, понятно 😄
Ha ha 🙂 Dastgoh is cheap but air is cheap too, I see
Свет сегодня ровный, в лаборатории всё работает. Хоть что-то радует
Да, по всему региону норма, Toktogul падает медленно, но это по графику
Ребят, кто в воскресенье на футбол на Чу-плац? Дастгох играет? Или Нефтчи
Неправильно спрашиваешь, Костя. Футбол у нас в Лиге закончился, Нефтчи чемпион уже с октября
Нефтчи чемпион, Тулпар второй. Кубок будет 7 ноября, Нефтчи против Attelkom, 2:0 мы забрали
Ой, я про кубок 🙈 Ладно, Нефтчи красавцы
Мужчины, вам бы про детей и школу говорить 😄
Hi! Is the Polytech evening Russian course still open? I want to ask Igor
Да, открыта, вечером. Запишитесь в деканат, не дорого. Дилноза знает расписание
Айгерим, записаться можно до конца ноября, потом будет группа с января
Thank you both! I'll go on Tuesday 🙂
Кто-нибудь ездил в Талас на маршрутке недавно? Сколько сейчас до Таласа, 38?
Нуржан–Талас маршрутка 38, как и было. Автобус 32, дешевле но медленнее
Спасибо! Тогда на автобус, Оксана экономит 😄
Монеты с Рабат-и-Сафеда в лаборатории всё лежат, а Игорь уже про них сны видит 🙃
Не сны, а расчёты 😤
Талас в Лиге сезон закрыл вторым, мы первые. Для Лиги это неплохо. Тулпар просил 62, мы 63
Андрей, ты бы ещё посчитал очки как в бухгалтерии Оксаны 😄
Я бы сказала, что у Нефтчи и Тулпара по очкам разница 1 балл, это не бухгалтерия, это арифметика
Вечер, Нуржан 🌙 Кто-нибудь видел, что в ISEZ в пятницу Нуржан выиграл у Семиза 5:2?
Да, Нуржан 5:2 Семиз, хорошо. Дастгох 5:2 у Кара-Булака тоже, в ISEZ 21 ноября
Ульак — не футбол, Айбек 😄 Кара-Булак в ISEZ у Дастгоха дома. Ну и сыграли, ладно
Костя, я знаю 😄 Ульак, Дастгох 5 Кара-Булак 2
Заодно: Talas 10:6 Kyzyl-Adyr в ульаке, и Lower Naryn 9:7 у Iyık Janyl. Вечер ульака
Ulak is so fast! My cousin plays for Talas sometimes 🙂
Ульак в ISEZ к следующей неделе, 28 ноября Хайлэнд. В Нуржане Хайлэнд не смотрят, но интересно
Газ для котельных: Herald опять пишет без тарифа. Совет молчит. Как и в прошлом году 🙃
Ну да. Пишите в ЖЭК, там тоже молчат
Топите, но окна держите закрытыми. Айгерим, как первый день на заводе?
Tiring but good 🙂 People are kind. Tomorrow is Monday, the second shift
Айгерим, не забудь маску на смене. И шарф 🧣
Кто завтра на Тулпар против Таласа в Лиге? Вроде Тулпар уже всё, сезон закрыт
Игорь, сезон закрыт. Тулпар второй, без игр. Ты путаешь с Кубком
Ладно, Нуржан, всем спокойной ночи. Завтра утром туман, наверное
Спокойной ночи! Окна закрыть, батарею протереть 😄
Ребят, в Нуржане воздух в ночи вообще как? Ходить с собакой страшно
Гуляй коротко, Костя, и маску возьми
Андрей здесь, на вахту в Сургут не еду в ноябре. Всем удачи
Андрей, молодец, дома с нами 🙂
Спокойной ночи, Нуржан 🌙
Good night all! 🌙 Thank you for the help today
Спокойной ночи, соседи 🌙

valleys.t: Morning valleys. Gateway is open but chains from the tunnel up, Ulan will tell you the rest
Chains yes. Tash-Kömür side still icy, I went slow. Afternoon bus is on
Kudai, my pupils came in with sniffles. Half the third grade has a cold
Tea with honey, the old way. Not selling it here 😄
Frost on the Chu fields this morning, -6 at the gate. Hay is stacked, sheep are happy
Kyzyl-Adyr -4 here. Dogs slept in the kitchen again, my wife is angry
Buyers came to my yard yesterday, 2.10 for small ones. Didn't sell. Waiting for March like everyone
Bakyt you will wait till March and the price will be 1.80 by then, trust me
Ulak Saturday! Talas v Kyzyl-Adyr 19:00 at the Hippodrome. Who is coming from the valleys
Toktogul bus leaves 15:30 for Talas, I'll be there if the pupils stop sneezing on me
Kyzyl-Adyr team is always late to the ground, ask Kubat's dogs to hurry them up
[sticker: haha]
Hay in the valleys 26 som a bale now. Went up again since the snow. Buy early, people
We bought in August at 18, cheap luck. Mairam you are our hay king
Kımbat, I'm a sheep woman, not a king 😂
Talas bus to Nurzhan 32 som. Marshrutka 38. Fog at Talas airport doesn't matter to me, the road is what counts
Power is normal in Talas, Nurzhan and Iyık Janyl today. No cuts planned for you lot. Toktogul, don't start
Nothing planned, nothing planned. Our street was dark for ten minutes at 8 and I screamed 🙃
[sticker: bilbeim]
Who has seen the Tulparcoin today? 3.33 cents at noon, up 4.6. Mairam your grandson will be happy
My grandson is happy every day, he is 9. Not legal tender baike
Tolgonay, your cellar block guy from Kara-Buura, did he ever post his number? No numbers here. Just asking if he is still alive
He is alive, sells blocks at 40 som a piece. Rest is your problem 😎
Rahmat. I will ask at the Kara-Buura yard, not here
Apples in Chu 3.45 a kilo now at the market. Mairam, your juice plan works after all
3.45 and nobody buys. Juice is in my jar, come and taste
Kids from Toktogul made a poster, I saw it on the Toktogul bus. Gateway is the way, true
Third grade is famous now 😂
Kyzyl-Adyr marshrutka to Talas 30 som. Still the same, the driver says it will go up. Let it go up
Whoever raised first, Tolgonay will say it was Kara-Buura again
[sticker: haha]
Walnuts at Toktogul bazar 22 a kilo, Ainura you were right. Anyone with a tree gets rich this winter
Shush, my father's trees are only three. The rest is the neighbour's
Dam at 82.7% full, drawing down. Summer water is gone, winter we are fine if the snow comes
Snow on the hills above Chu still. Sheep are sulking
Ulak Saturday reminder. Talas v Kyzyl-Adyr 19:00 at the State Hippodrome, Talas. Bring the dogs, no they stay home
Dogs at the Hippodrome. Kubat, please no
Who thinks Talas wins? I say Kyzyl-Adyr, they have the better wind
Talas always wins at home, the wind doesn't matter
[poll: Who goes to the Hippodrome Saturday? | Me / No, it's cold / I'll watch the dogs]
Poll is rigged. Dogs vote too
Gn valleys. Kids, don't sleep with the light on, it's not Christmas
Gn Jamilya 🌙
Snow on the Chu hills is still there. Gn all
Kim online? Power is off again in our street. Phone at 9%
Kayırluu tañ. Frost on the window, the sheep are complaining already
Tañ. Frost is nothing, wait till the snow comes down to the valley
Fergana Gateway open this morning. Chains or winter tyres, nobody gets through without them. Ala-Bel side is fine
Ulan, is the tunnel side still slow?
Slow but moving. Drive like you have grandmother in the back seat
Potato buyers still at 90 tyiyn in Kyzyl-Adyr. Bakyt, did you sell yet?
Sold 2 tonnes to a man from Talas. Kept the rest in the shed. He pays on the day, that's something
On the day. Nice. Mine are still in the cellar, not the brigade's cellar, my cellar
Morning. Kara-Buura smells of smoke again, everyone burning whatever they have
Coal is 2 som more in our shop. Nobody says why
Because the shop has to eat too 😂
Toktogul reservoir 82.4% full today and still going down. Dam gives what the schedule says. Winter water is fine if snow comes
Ainura, you sound like the Herald now 😄
Teachers read the news too, jok. Kids ask me about it in class
Hay 26 som a bale now at the Chu market. Mairam, did you buy the cheap ones in August?
Yes, kudayga shükür. Still have 40 bales, sheep will eat them by February
Hay for the dogs is the real problem. Dogs eat more than my wife
Ha. Ask Kubat's wife about that one
Who is going to the Hippodrome tonight? Talas v Kyzyl-Adyr. Ticket price still the same as last year?
Ticket same. Cold is the price, bring a blanket and a flask
I go to Chu plain ground tomorrow, Nurzhan vs Semiz is at 16:00 there. Not the same sport, I know
Ulak is tonight, football is tomorrow, ChuValleyFarmer you are confused, jok
Lunch. Pole at Kara-Buura is leaning again. Told the office, they say next month
Next month is their favourite month
Tulparcoin 3.29 cents at noon, down 1.4. Ha, the grandson is sad now
Not legal tender baike. Sell your sheep, not your Tulparcoin
Sun out in Kara-Buura for once. Hanging the wash on the balcony, don't tell me it will freeze
[sticker: jakshi]
Walnuts still 22 som at the bazar. Ask for the ones from the top row, the rest is dry
Top row, got it. Bought 2 kilos for the kids
Afternoon marshrutka to Iyık Janyl is on. Going at 16:00 if the road holds
Rahmat Ulan. Tell the driver not to stop at every tea house
Power normal in Talas, Nurzhan, Iyık Janyl. No cuts planned tonight. Chu, check your own lines, I don't work there tonight
Good. Last week 18:00 to 20:00 every day in Chu. Thank you Sapar
Not my decision, apa. I just climb the poles
Snow still on the hills above Chu. Sheep are back to normal, eating like nothing happened
[sticker: jailoo]
Hippodrome tonight, 19:00 Talas v Kyzyl-Adyr. Who is taking the dogs? Nobody? Good
Dogs stay home. The wind is strong in Talas, Ulan says it doesn't matter
It doesn't matter for Talas. For you it matters 😂
Enjoy the cold. I'll be in bed by 21:00 with the stove on
Nurzhan air is bad again today, AQI 160 they say. My cousin there cannot open the window
Inversion, the smoke sits in the bowl. Wind from the north would fix it. Not holding my breath
Gn valleys. Kids, sleep, it's Saturday but still school tomorrow for some
Gn Jamilya 🌙 Kubat, tell us the score tomorrow, no dogs
Gn all. Good night from the cold potato shed
Who is still awake? Baby teeth again, I give up on sleep
Night shift at the pole in Kara-Buura. Not awake, just cold
Kayırluu tañ. Frost on the window, stove already lit. Sheep fine?
Fine. Snow on the hills, the lambs complaining. Kayırluu tañ
Fergana Gateway: open, but chains or winter tyres needed. Ice at the tunnel mouth, slow down
Ulan you are our morning news. Toktogul side is dry, just cold -1 at night 🥶
Talas side is clear and cold, 6 at most. Dress in layers Ainura apa
Potatoes in the shed still 2.10 a kilo at the bazar in Talas. My shed is colder than the bazar
You keep them cold, that's the trick. Don't sell at 2.10, wait for the spring
Spring. Who has a cellar that doesn't flood? Mine floods every April 😄
Cousin in Kara-Buura says the block cellar is nearly done. Will post pictures when he remembers to charge his phone
Rahmat Sapar. Send the pictures and I'll send you a bag of potatoes
Hay in the valleys 26 som a bale now. Went up again since last week. Who is selling cheap?
Nobody cheap. Ask in Kara-Buura, they have the hay from the south slope
We bought ours in August at 18, so I'm fine, kudayga shükür. Just counting for the neighbours
Kara-Buura drivers raised diesel first again? I hear 6.10 at the station by the bridge
6.10 is the official diesel price, the same everywhere. Don't believe the rumours at the bridge
Ok ok. I just want the pump to stop going up every week 😅
Toktogul reservoir 82.1% full and going down, they say 57 million m³ in one day. The dam is still making power 🙃
Drawing down on schedule. The exports go by contract, the lake doesn't care who is cold
Our street had light all night, so I'm happy. Who did you bribe, Sapar? 😂
Nobody. We just had no faults on our line. Kids, don't climb the poles
Ulak fans, Kara-Bulak and Kyzyl-Adyr? Nobody told me the ISEZ table yet
Kubat, the ISEZ table is on Jarysh. Round 11 was yesterday, Talas beat Kyzyl-Adyr 10–6. Sorry for you
Ooba. 10 to 6. My dogs would have run faster 😄
Dastgoh beat Kara-Bulak 5–2 too. Nurzhan 5–2 Semiz. Chu is still top with 26, come on Chu
Chu top. Write it on the wall. Play-off semi against the Highland second place, 12 December at the hippodrome
12 December at the hippodrome, 19:00. Sheep stay at home, I'll go in the cold 🥶
Walnuts at the Toktogul bazar still 22 som a kilo? My brother wants some for the new year
22, yes. Top row only, the rest is dry. Buy a kilo first, see
Lunch: plov from the cafe near the bus stop, 28 som a plate. Not bad for Sunday
Plov is 28 everywhere now. Just don't take the one with no meat 😂
The Herald says Nurzhan air is 234 today. Very unhealthy. Mine is moderate, so I'm shipping the dogs out of there
Inversion. The smoke sits in the bowl. My cousin in Nurzhan is wearing a mask in his own flat
Talas is 100 and Iyık Janyl 163. Breathing in the valleys is a lottery this winter
Chu air is fine, the wind keeps it moving. Come to Chu, we have sheep and no smoke
Tulparcoin at noon 3.40 cents, up 3.5. Still not legal tender, I checked with my wife 😂
Sell your sheep, not your Tulparcoin, Bakyt said that yesterday. Stop it
Marshrutka Talas–Kyzyl-Adyr still 30 som. Bus Talas–Nurzhan 32. Afternoon run is on, roads dry
Thanks Ulan. Ours is still 30, good. Who is going to Talas tomorrow? Bring me a kalpak
Kids back from the school trip to the Toktogul dam. Cold but happy. They want the photos on the wall
Power normal in Talas, Nurzhan, Iyık Janyl. No scheduled cuts tonight. Chu, check the lines yourselves
Thank you Sapar. Two nights of 18:00 to 20:00 and I'm writing a letter, joke. Sort of
Snow on the high jailoo still. Sheep eat hay in the shed now, not the grass. Wish I had less hay 😅
Anyone watched the Women's League? Universitet beat Iyık Janyl 3–2 last round. Tulpar Women drew 2–2 with Akademiya
Attelkom women lost 3–0 to Nurzhan. Their last round, season is done. Tulpar top with 23, Universitet 22
Men's league is done too. Neftchi champions, 63 points, Tulpar 62. One point, Kubat's dogs would have barked the whole way
Dogs did not bark, they sat. Irad Cup final is 7 November, Neftchi 2–0 Attelkom. That's old news now, I know
Highland ulak: Boztorgoy 11–4 Tanıp last Saturday. Round 12 is next Saturday, Boztorgoy v Moiynkum at 13:00
Moiynkum winter grounds. Road up there is bad in this snow, bring chains or stay home
Cold coming down. Stove on, sheep in, the cat is on the stove where it belongs 🐱
Sunday evening, Ainura, the lights in Toktogul should be fine tonight. Ask me if not
Ask you? I will call the whole pole crew 🙃
Tomorrow school. Kids, teeth, bags, I'm going to bed like it's 21:00
Kara-Buura pole still leaning? Sapar, next month again?
Next month. Their favourite month. I told you
Who is going to the Nurzhan side with a load of potatoes next week? Ask price there, not Talas prices
Nurzhan side is 750 to 1,200 for a flat a month, potatoes I don't know. Ask Kubat, he sells to everyone
I sell to whoever pays on time. Nurzhan pays late. Bring cash
Cousin in Nurzhan says the air is 196 at night and the smoke is in the bedroom. Stay home if you can
Inversion till Tuesday maybe. The north wind is what we need, not prayers
Tomorrow I'm taking the first load of hay to Chu side. Pray the road holds, Ulan
Road holds. Just take chains, Mairam, Talas side wind is strong at night
Gn valleys. Kubat, dogs, cold shed, go to sleep 🌙
Gn all. Potatoes are fine, I checked them three times
Gn. Kudai saktasın hammeege 🌙

horses.t: Morning. Fog on the Talas road again, drive slow. Fog at the airport too, check the board before you go
Ulak tonight? No, tomorrow. Round 11 Talas v Kyzyl-Adyr at 19:00, Kerim please write it down 😂
I wrote it down!! Saturday 19:00 at the Hippodrome 🤦 Dilbar is going to kill me
Nobody needs to kill anyone. Talas 22, Kyzyl-Adyr 13, we need the three points
Morning! Exams week, I am drinking coffee with a horse book open. Send help 📚
Lucerne deal is done, 22 a bale with delivery if I take 60. The Chu man is honest
Good man. I still need a farrier though, my Chongtor is walking funny
Gate 2, grey beard, I said it already 😄 Check the hoof for a stone first, a lost shoe can hide a bruise
Ok doctor. Its a stone, I checked. Thanks
Colt ate a full bucket of hay this morning and tried to lick the stable cat 😂
The cat will win in the end
Semiz still on 2 points in the Conference. Their riders are great though, the Semiz bride-chase at the last wedding was legendary
Chase is not the same as a fair game, Kerim 😂 but yes, they ride well
Lunch with the tyre boys. Someone asked me today if a new tyre shop will open in Talas. I said ask the Hippodrome first, everything opens there
Ha. Opening is easy, the bales are hard
Fog is lifting in Talas now, the airport still held. Check before you go
Chabysh on Sunday is still on? Rysbek, tell me the road
Road is dry on the Talas side. Ice near the bridge. Going by the valley road 👍
Good. Two young horses, one colt in the back of the truck wrapped like a parcel
Keep the colt in the truck cab's warm side and not in the wind, it chills fast. Air in Nurzhan is bad too today, keep the foals indoors
Quick ulak question: Iyık Janyl got 5-4 over Nurzhan last round. Can they still reach the top 4?
They can, they are 16 points. Dastgoh 16 too. Nobody is safe in the middle
Post the table again Kerim, I'm not searching for it 😂
Table in my head: Chu 26, Talas 22, Dastgoh 16, Iyık Janyl 16, Nurzhan 15, Kyzyl-Adyr 13. Done
Kara-Bulak 12, Lower Naryn 12, Sary-Bulak 7, Köhne Diz 7, Semiz 2. There, saved you 😄
Saturday I am going to the Hippodrome stands with the thermos. Cold weather, hot tea 🍵
Bring a blanket for the stands, the wind comes from the north at 21:00 now
Heard someone say Syndicate lot again. No more, Aidana is right
Thank you 🙏 Real horses only
Our Akyel colt is 3 months now. Still has the doran on his shoulders. Azim, you should see him, he is doing great
Send me a photo of the stable tomorrow morning, no animals in it please, just the setup 🙂
Diesel in the valley is 6.10 a litre now, my truck drinks it like water
Ha, the Chatkal village drivers pay even more. 8.55 to 9.75 up there, they buy fuel by the bucket
Then stay in Talas, the Hippodrome is warmer 😂
[poll: Saturday's ulak: Talas v Kyzyl-Adyr, who wins?]
Talas. Obviously. Stands will be full 🐎
Talas 🐎 Kyzyl-Adyr will be sad but they know it
Night before the big ulak. Kyz kuu practice in the yard tomorrow, the groom is already scared 😂
Good luck Talas. Night all
Good night all. Keep the bales dry and the foals warm 🌙
Morning. Frost on the Hippodrome gate this morning, my tea froze in the thermos lid 🥶
Frost is nothing. Wait till the Otmek wind. Dress warm for the stands tonight
Tonight is ulak in Talas! 19:00 at the Hippodrome, Talas v Kyzyl-Adyr 🐎 wear the big kalpak
Kyzyl-Adyr will bring the young ones, I heard. Talas still has the old riders, so cheer for them 😄
Poll: who scores first tonight?
Chabysh was good yesterday! Two horses fine, colt happy in the truck. Rahmat Rysbek for the road 🙏
Glad it went well. Ice near the bridge was real though, slow down on the valley road
Nurzhan air today is bad, AQI 160 on the screen. Keep the old horses out of the smog if you can
Yes, keep them indoors if you can, and water them well. Dust in the lungs is no joke
Hay update: I found 40 bales from a farm near Kara-Buura. Still need 20 more. Anyone?
Valley hay is 26 a bale now. Chu side was 22 last week, if you bring a truck
Same story every year. Buy early, pay later 😩
Round 10 check: Lower Naryn 7–6 Kara-Bulak, that was a crazy game. Kyzyl-Adyr 4–2 over Köhne Diz 😄
Talas 2–3 Dastgoh, we lost that one. Chu 6–3 Sary-Bulak. Iyık Janyl 5–4 Nurzhan again ugh
Iyık Janyl are on fire. 16 points now, same as Dastgoh
Who is playing today? I can't keep up
Nurzhan v Semiz at 16:00 on the Chu plain, Dastgoh v Kara-Bulak at 16:00 at their works ground. Both done soon?
Round 11 is today! Talas v Kyzyl-Adyr 19:00, Köhne Diz v Sary-Bulak 21:00 at the Hippodrome. Long night
Wear something warm, the stands get cold after 21:00 🥶
Ulak is on! Talas v Kyzyl-Adyr, first half is full stands already 🐎
Kyzyl-Adyr should have brought better kalpaks lol 😂
Köhne Diz still on zero from the early games? Oh wait, they had 7 points. Tonight is their game, they need it
Final results will be posted by the Directorate. Good night all, check your foals first 🌙
Good ulak night. Thermos is empty, going home. Night all 🐎
Night! Kyz kuu practice tomorrow in the yard, the groom is still scared 😂
Who was up for the Talas v Kyzyl-Adyr result? Aidana, did Talas win in the end? 😴
Morning horse people. Frost on the windscreen, the mares are fine though
Mares fine, Marat? Mine are blanketed since last night, dont tell me it wasnt needed
😄 you are always the careful one
Talas 10–6 over Kyzyl-Adyr!! The old riders showed up 🔥
Finally I can sleep. Kyzyl-Adyr brought the kalpaks at least
Boztorgoy are a machine. 30 pts and they still look hungry
Karakoyun v Naiman not received yet, so nobody knows. Directorate is slow again
Sheets go in by noon usually. Be patient
Nurzhan air this morning is awful. Bad on my chest just walking to the stables
Same, the colt has been coughing a bit. I keep him in the stable with the window shut
Keep him in, wet hay is worse with the smog. Check his breathing twice a day. If it doesnt settle call me at the centre
Rahmat doctor 🙏 I will watch him tonight
Still looking for 20 bales. Valley hay is 26 a bale, cant argue with that, the price is the price
Chu side maybe 22 if you bring your own truck. Still early, the snow will push it up
Buy early, pay later as always 😩
Ice on the valley road again this morning. Anyone going to Nurzhan today?
Not me, Nurzhan air is 234 on the screen. Staying in Talas with the window closed
Talas AQI 100, moderate. Honestly Talas is easy to breathe this week
Kyz kuu practice in the yard at 11. The groom is back, he brought a helmet this time 😂
Smart groom. Ask him to keep the helmet on for the whip part too
Temir! I will be gentle, promise 😄
[sticker: horse_love]
Anyone watching the Irad Cup final? Neftchi v Attelkom on the 7th. Who do you think?
Neftchi, they won the league already. Attelkom had a good last round but 2-0 for Neftchi is my guess
Tulpar fans are upset Neftchi got the title by 1 point 😂 Tulpar had 62 and Neftchi 63
A point is a point. Neftchi beat Tulpar 2–1 in the last round, that was the day
Lunch break. Plov at the bazar is 28 a plate, I still buy it every day
Plov at 28 and the tea is free, not bad
Colt is breathing easier after lunch. Still watching him
Good. Dont let him roll in the wet straw. Dry bedding only
Trans-Talas road, a tyre shop day. Three trucks with bald tyres already this afternoon, no surprise with the ice
Winter tyres on before the Otmek wind, Marat. Your own shop should know that 😄
Ha, the shoemaker has no shoes 🐎
Remember the sheep taken from Korgoncho pen? Two held, nine sheep found. Cheap sheep are still expensive
Sheep and horses, the thieves never get tired
Toktogul is 82 percent full and still drawing down. Grandma is worried about the power, she always is
Power is normal in all three cities, dont worry grandma 😄
Tonight nothing at the Hippodrome, right? Next ulak is the 28th? Highland round 12 is Saturday
Highland round 12 is the 28th: Boztorgoy v Moiynkum at 13:00 at the winter grounds. Sets it up
Boztorgoy will smash Moiynkum. Akjele v Karakoyun at Upper Besh-Tash is the one I care about
Chubar v Kökjal at Arslanbob, 15:00. I'll drive out, the road is clear
[sticker: kalpak]
Anyone going to the play-off semis on 12 Dec? Chu v the Highland place 2 at 19:00
Yes I have tickets. Stands get cold after 21:00, bring a thermos
Talas plays the second semi at 21:00 vs Highland place 1. Kyz kuu demo at halftime, I asked the Hippodrome already
Demo? Aidana you will fall off in front of the whole city 😂
Only if the groom holds the horse 😄
Colt temperature normal now. Good sign Gulsara
Rahmat Azim! Feeling better already 🙏
Irad Cup final 7 Nov is done already, so Neftchi 2-0 Attelkom. Congrats to Neftchi
Askat that's the 7th of November, it is the 22nd now. Did you mean the Irad Cup final on the 7th, we already had that
Yes yes, I mixed my dates. Old man memory 😩
Good night all. Snow on the Otmek ridge tonight, the Hippodrome stables are warm though 🐎
Night horse people 🌙
Night! Practice tomorrow, the groom is still scared 😂

football.t: Morning. -6 in the yard, the windscreen is a fridge 🥶
Talas is in fog, can't see the bank sign from the bus stop. Airport says flights held till 10:35 🌫️
Fog and -6 and nobody has said anything about the match yet. Lazy lot 🐆
Derby is over, Ermek. We are champions, we can relax 🖤🧡
Champions with 1 point gap and 0 games left. Enjoy it Andrei 😂
Irad Cup final is Saturday the 7th? Wait it was already. Neftchi 2–0 Attelkom. Sad day for Talas 😔
Don't remind me. Attelkom had the ball for 60 minutes and still lost
Sorry boys but the cup was one good match, the league is the real thing
Нефтяник чемпион, не надо спорить 🖤🧡
Один ноль нам не нравится, Вика 😄
Lunch and ulak on the phone. Talas v Kyzyl-Adyr 19:00 Saturday, Hippodrome, tickets already sold out? 🐎
Not sold out, the stands are cold though. Bring two blankets Pablo
Hay in the valleys is 26 som a bale now. My cousin says the horse people are crying 😅
Good thing the horses at the Hippodrome are not on football wages 🐎
Shift B starts 19:00 again. Who is covering the Friday coffee machine? 😩
Not me, I'm on the 4:00 train to Talas tomorrow. Leaving the coffee to Andrei
Students at the library say the Women's League final table is 23 Tulpar, 22 Universitet, 16 Attelkom. Women won it, nobody posts it again 🙄
Ha, Azat already said this on Thursday. Tulpar women are champions of the table, well done girls 👏
Congrats to the women. Our men sit 2nd with 62 and Neftchi on 63, one point ahead 🤍
Все такие смешные 😂 Мы чемпионы, вы второй
Второй с 62 очками, Вика, не забываем 😄
Potatoes 2.10 som a kilo at the Bazar this week, I'm selling at 2.10 too, no more 😅
Bakyt you sell more than that. Your cellar is the Iradi granary
Cellar is for winter. Nothing goes out till March 🥔
Dastgoh v Kara-Bulak is Saturday 16:00 at the Dastgoh works ground. Not ours, but I'd bet on Dastgoh 🤷
Dastgoh are 3rd on 42. They will win 🐆
Smog in Nurzhan today, AQI 152. I can taste it. Keep the windows shut 😷
Talas is 110, only sensitive groups, you lot are dying 😂
Coal lorry came today, ton ordered, now I can't see my own street 😅
Azamat from Kara-Buura, you still say Kara-Buura will be 2–0 down in Kyzyl-Adyr? 😂
We were 2–0 up on Attelkom and lost, we know how it goes. Saturday is a Kara-Buura day 🟢
Deportivo Semiz 3rd in First League, I keep saying 😤
Pablo we have never heard of Deportivo Semiz 😂
Good. That's how you know it's ours
Tickets for the derby next year: club says the Kara-Ak section will be the same, ID at the gate
Пускают по паспорту, я уже проверила 🧣
Night shift for me now. Nurzhan vs Talas next season, I'll bring the warm jacket 🖤🧡
Bring the jacket, Andrei. Talas will bring the sun 🤍
Who's going to Kyzyl-Adyr on Saturday, the bus from Talas is 30 som on the marshrutka?
Marshrutka 30 som, yes. Bus to Iyık Janyl is 45, don't take that by mistake 🐆
Nazgul, the Hippodrome is in Talas itself, you walk. No bus needed 😂
Oh. So I paid nothing for nothing. Good 😅
Temirjolchu on 31 points, hope they stay up. Naryn are already down with 8 🙏
Naryn with 8 is not a football club, it is a raffle 😂
Hey, that's Azat's line from the morning!
Round 11 ulak Saturday: Chu v Semiz is in Nurzhan at 16:00. Talas v Kyzyl-Adyr Hippodrome 19:00, I'll be there 🐎
Kyzyl-Adyr is 13 points, we are 22. Three points is nothing if we play like the Chu game 🤍
Chu 26, you're at 22, Timur, stop counting like a banker 😂
Кто-нибудь знает, когда матчи Нефтяника в январе? Хочу взять абонемент 🤔
Club will post the calendar. Ask at the gate, Vika, they know everything 👍
Reminder: Talas v Kyzyl-Adyr Saturday 19:00, Hippodrome. Bring blankets, no excuses 🐆
I'll bring a bag of walnuts for the stand. Toktogul ones at 22 som a kilo, sharing with Ermek 🌰
Walnuts are 22 som a kilo, I'm buying a sack. Cheaper than the stand kiosk 😂
Night lads. Kara-Ak derby is at NurGaz next season 🖤🧡🤍
Night. Talas is still second, that's enough for me 🤍
Night. Deportivo Semiz 3rd in First League, don't forget 😤
Morning. Frost on the potatoes already, -6 at the field. Hope the Hippodrome pitch is not a skating rink tonight 😅
Talas pitch is fine, it's the stand that freezes. Bring the blanket Bakyt
Who's going to the Chu game in Nurzhan at 16:00? Dastgoh vs Kara-Bulak is the same time, can't do both 😩
Ulak is for the people who like to suffer. Chu v Semiz is the one I'd watch, they are 26 pts for a reason
Refinery shift done, just got home. Nurzhan smog is thick this morning, can't see the chimney from my kitchen 😷
Мама сказала не ходить на улицу без маски. AQI 160 у нас, это ужас
Yeah it's 160 in Nurzhan. Talas is 90, go visit the valley if you want air 😂
Cup final is on the 7th and Neftchi beat Attelkom 2–0. Still feels weird to say it out loud
Attelkom played well for an hour. Then the sun came out at the wrong moment for them 😂
Attelkom are not a cup team, they are a cup-final team. Different things 😤
Women's League wrap: we finished 1st on 23, Universitet 2nd on 22. Our last round was 2–2 with Akademiya, I'm still annoyed
Tulpar women top of the table, Nazgul you should be happy 🤍
I am happy. I'm also annoyed. Both is fine 😄
[sticker: jailoo]
Ermek that is a picture of a yurt in the snow, nobody is going to the jailoo in November
I am going to the jailoo in my dreams. Hay is 26 som a bale in the valleys now, I bought 10 for my cow, I'm broke 😭
Hay at 26 and you still come to the match 🤣 respect
Derby is over, that's it. Neftchi champions, I can say it now. 2026 🖤🧡
You won by one point, Andrei. Don't make a speech about it
63 to 62 is a speech 😎
Нефтяник чемпион! Папа сказал, что будет праздник на НурГаз 🖤🧡
Temirjolchu finished 7th on 31, that's a good season for a club with a budget of a raffle 👏
Serious question: what's the point of the Talas Herald writing about the Chatkal leopards when we can't even get a stadium toilet 😂
Cameras found three snow leopards and no compensation for the herders. That's the real story, Azat
Yeah fair. Herders get nothing and we get a 5-som kiosk coffee 😅
Hippodrome tonight 19:00 vs Kyzyl-Adyr. Anyone coming from town? Walk from the centre, no bus needed 😂
Nazgul is walking this time, I checked. Marshrutka is 30 but I'm not paying for nothing again
Walnuts for the stand, Bakyt's Toktogul ones at 22 som a kilo. I'm buying two bags 🌰
Two bags is a lot Ermek, the stand will smell like a bakery 😄
Chu v Semiz result is in the ulak sheet? Not yet for me, it's still on the pitch 🐎
[sticker: haha]
Кто-нибудь знает, есть ли билеты на финал Кубка? Хочу на 7 ноября... ой, это уже прошло 🙈
Final was on the 7th, Vika. You're a bit late for that one. Next year's calendar comes from the club office
Понятно. Спасибо, Андрей 🖤
Two hours to kick-off on the Hippodrome. Who is in the stand, you lot? 🤍
Jolbors in the stand with the walnuts 🐆🌰
Me too. Kyzyl-Adyr are 13 pts, we are not scared of 13 🐎
Pablo, Kyzyl-Adyr have a 7-goal game in them somewhere, careful 😂
Cold tonight, Talas 5 high, -6 low. Bring the thermos, not the beer 🍵
Game at 19:00 is the Talas one, the kick-off is listed as in the Hippodrome. Ah. Not football, this is ulak 😂
Ulak Talas v Kyzyl-Adyr, the Hippodrome. Football is Köhne Diz v Sary-Bulak at 21:00 same place. Two games at the same ground tonight 🐎
Football fans, shut it, we are the only ones with a proper sport tonight 😂
Ulak 19:00 started, I can hear the horses from my flat. Talas will not lose on a Saturday 🤍
Night game lads, the air is bad in Nurzhan so Talas is breathing better 😂
Lower Naryn 7–6 Kara-Bulak last week btw, who watches these games, I'm not even sure they're real 😂
Real enough. I've got a bag of walnuts and a team to support, that's real
Sunday I'm not doing anything. Football on Monday? Who knows. Let me sleep first 😴
[sticker: tlpr_up]
Night shift tomorrow, no derby this week. Good night from Nurzhan 🖤🧡
Спокойной ночи всем 🧣
Night. Walnuts gone, Bakyt owes me 2 kilos 😂
Write it down Ermek, the walnuts are in the stand, not in my bag 🌰
Night. Deportivo Semiz 3rd in First League, don't forget 😤
Still up. Who has the ulak sheet for the Hippodrome tonight? Lower Naryn stuff is on the sheet, Semiz not yet 🐎
Morning Jolbors. Did the walnuts survive the night or is Bakyt still in debt 😂
Bakyt paid 1 kilo, says the other is a 'stand tax' 🌰
Fake news. It was a loan. Cold on the pitch in Talas this morning, the potato rows were white
Sunday off. Coffee, then the table. We are 1 point behind Neftchi and the season is over, that's a sad sentence 😔
63 to 62. You had your chance 😎 Congrats on the 2nd place though, nobody expected it in March
Talas air 100 today, moderate. Nurzhan is 234. Andrei, how do you breathe in that city 🙄
With the window shut and a bad mask. Heat plant gas switch still not funded, so it's the same story every morning
Herald says the air needs a source count. Who would count, the same people who fund the gas?
Андрей, сколько стоит билет на выездной матч в Талас? Хочу посмотреть на Тулпар вживую 🧣
Vika, the away section is only through the club and only with ID. Ask at the office, don't buy from the guy outside 😅
Cup final was Neftchi 2–0 Attelkom, so nobody here needs to say anything about cups today 😂
Not the cup, the women's league. Tulpar women top with 23, Universitet 22. Nazgul told us already
Yes Azat, and I'm saying it again. 2–2 with Akademiya last round, but still top 🤍
[poll: Ulak Talas vs Kyzyl-Adyr 2 weeks back, who was better on the pitch?]
Honest answer: the horses. Ulak is the real sport 🐎
Pablo, every week you say that and every week I have to answer 😂
Hay is 26 a bale in the valleys now. Last year it was 19. My horses don't read the table, they just eat 🐆
Tell me about it. Potatoes at 2.10 a kilo at the gate and nobody wants them. Winter is going to be long 🥔
Night shift from tonight. Derby for next season already on the calendar? Club office says spring
Spring is ages. I'll be at the Hippodrome for the play-off final on 19 Dec, that's the real calendar for me
Play-offs: Chu v Highland place 2 on 12 Dec, Highland place 1 v Talas 21:00. Talas in the ulak play-offs, not the football, lol
Semiz is 2 points in the ISEZ, nobody says the word Semiz 😤
Pablo, you say it every day. Maybe that's why people don't
Спасибо Андрей за ответ, я спрошу в офисе клуба 🖤
Good, Vika. And wear the warm jacket, the east stand is cold even in the day 🧥
Who is coming to Kara-Buura on the 28th? Pass is closed for the winter, the old road too. Have to go through Kara-Buura pass by the high road? No, wait, that's closed too 😅
Sasha, the Kara-Buura Pass is closed for winter. Football goes by the Fergana Gateway with chains, or you stay home 😄
Round 12 is Saturday. Nobody needs a pass to see the table, we all know it
Sunset at 17:20 and the valley already smells of coal. Heating is on, the smog is on 😷
Tulparcoin is 3.40 cents today, up 3.5%. Someone tell Bakyt to buy 🪙
I'd rather buy a sack of potatoes. At least I know what they weigh 😂
Ulak Talas will be in the Hippodrome on Saturday again I guess? Tickets for Dec 12 already on sale? 🐎
Ask the office, I don't do tickets for the ulak. Good luck to Talas, really 🖤🧡
Evening all. Round 11 ulak: Dastgoh 5–2 Kara-Bulak, Nurzhan 5–2 Semiz. Pablo's going to have something to say 😅
Yes I have something to say: Semiz is in the sheet, not in the table 😤
Pablo calm down, Semiz is 11 games in and it's 2 points, nobody's surprised 😂
А кто выиграл у Кара-Булака? 🤔
Dastgoh 5–2, Vika. Kara-Bulak are at 12 pts, they stayed in the mix 😄
Herald piece on the sheep: two held over 11 taken from Korgoncho, nine back. Bakyt, is that your pen?
Not mine, I have 4 ha of potatoes and zero sheep. Good luck to the Korgoncho lot
Toktogul is 82.1% full and drawing down. Power normal in all three cities. Something good for once 🙏
Normal power in Nurzhan too. I'll take that. The air is the other thing
Bought walnuts at Toktogul bazar, 22 a kilo, the price is still not a joke 🌰
Bring me a bag next time Ermek, I'll pay this time 🐎
Deal. Pablo pays, Bakyt owes, the stand gets the walnuts 😂
I'm not in this one, I'm a potato man 🥔
Night game for the Hippodrome on 12 Dec, cold but worth it. Sunday tomorrow, get some sleep lads 🤍
Night shift tomorrow. Good night Talas, good night Semiz. Pablo calm down 🖤🧡
Night Andrei. Deportivo Semiz, 3rd in First League. Don't forget 😤
Спокойной ночи всем 🧣
Night. Tulpar women top, Talas breathing, Nurzhan not so much 🤍
Night. Court on the coin is on the 16th, I hope the students in the scarves are there too 😂
Both sides of the scarf, Azamat 😄 Good night
Night. Potatoes are still in the ground, I'm going to sleep like one 🥔
Night all. Round 12 Saturday, Boztorgoy v Moiynkum 13:00 in the winter grounds. Jolbors goes, walnuts in the bag 🐆
Night. Table is done, season is done, the spring is far. Sleep well 😴

diaspora.t: Can't sleep, kids have school tomorrow and I'm reading the Herald on my phone like a grandmother 😅
Morning from Ansan. Snow in the forecast here, first of the year 🥶
-20 in Novosib this morning. My car started on the third try, the battery is old
Mum says Talas is fog this morning, flights held till about 10:35 at the airport. Don't book anything that needs to land early 😩
Dad says the fog is in the valley again. Every November the same story
Mum also says the bazar changers are at 11.55 buy for dollars this morning. Still silly to change at home, I'll wait
Waiting is the Irad national sport 😂
Reading the Herald: 40 Rim pilgrims stuck in Tashkent for a week and we have no consul to call. Who do families even ring?
Nobody. That's the problem. My cousin's kid was in that group, she says they were sleeping in a hostel near the station
Sending prayers and a bit of money to whoever is paying for the hostel 🙏
Jasil walnuts from Toktogul are 22 som a kilo at the bazar, my aunt is buying 10 kilos for the cold months
22 for walnuts is nothing. Remember when we cracked them with a stone on the balcony? 😄
[sticker: nan]
Lunch: found a shop in Walthamstow with Kyrgyz tea. Not Iradi, but it's the closest thing
Tea without chai is sad. Bring some to Talas in December and I'll make it right
Those 'Tulpar gold' tea tins from Almaty are fake, my cousin got one 😂
Haha he's joking, the Almaty ones are good, just overpriced
Tulparcoin is at 3.33 cents this noon, up 4.6% today. My colleague in Berlin says he's not touching it again
Smart colleague. I still have my free 100 and I'm not looking at it
[sticker: haha]
Saturday plan: ulak on the stream? Is the Hippodrome game on Irad TV or only online?
Only the Directorate's stream, the Hippodrome one. Mum says the Talas seats are sold out for the 21st
Talas v Kyzyl-Adyr at 19:00, Köhne Diz v Sary-Bulak at 21:00 at the State Hippodrome. Good night of ulak 🐎
Chicago time that's Saturday 4am. I'll be asleep with my phone on 😂
Cold question again: Fergana Gateway still open with chains? Driving to Talas from Nurzhan for the ulak
Yes open, winter tyres or chains required. Don't take the old road, it's closed for winter
Mum says Nurzhan is smoggy again, the air is unhealthy, 152 on the US scale. Kids can't go out 😷
Same in Talas, 110 today. Heating season, everyone burning coal. Mum says wear the mask on the bus
Korea feels like Talas heating season: dry air, everyone with a heater in the room 😂
Seoul you keep saying that 😂
The reservoir is 82.7% full, Dad says drawing down 53 million m³ a day. Hope they keep the exports on schedule 🤞
Power is normal in Talas and Nurzhan, no cuts. Dad says the district heating is on too
Good. Nothing worse than a cold flat in London in November, I'm talking about Talas 😅
Highland update: Boztorgoy 27 pts, Tanıp 22, round 11 Saturday 13:00 at Moiynkum winter grounds. Who's going?
Nobody going to Moiynkum in November 😂 I'll watch the Arslanbob one
Mum asks if the Talas 1-room flats are still 1,000 to 1,500 a month. She wants to buy for my cousin
Nurzhan is cheaper, 750 to 1,200 for a one-room. Iyık Janyl 600 to 1,000 if she's brave
Buy a flat, don't buy a Tulparcoin 😄
Who wants to bet on the title? Neftchi 63, Tulpar 62, one point, no rounds left 😬
Neftchi already champions though, the season is finished. Still, the one point gap is wild
[sticker: jailoo]
Apples in Chu are 3.45 a kilo this week, my cousin says the valleys are full this year 🍎
Apples and walnuts. Irad is the one with the apples and horses, my kids say it every day now 😄
Hay in the valleys is 26 som a bale. Dad says buy now before it goes up in January 🐴
Dad's cousin keeps two horses in Kara-Koyun. He says hay is the real worry, not the cold
